name: uniclyNFT
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to deposit, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a short multi-step AMM reserve-manipulation attack using a flash loan, initial swap, repeated token transfers plus skim calls to distort pair balances, and a final swap to extract profit. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair accounting and skim behavior rather than just spotting a trivial access-control bug, but the PoC is still compact and not deeply protocol-internal.
